descriptions.value: The TrueBooker WordPress plugin before 1.3.0 does not have authorisation checks in place in some of its functionality, allowing unauthenticated users to create and modify booking services and categories, including their prices.

assertions.title: TrueBooker Appointment Booking 1.1.9 - 1.2.9 - Unauthenticated Service and Category Creation and Modification
